description: This file contains implementation of stack trace dumping and symbolization functions for debugging purposes within the Abseil library, including platform-specific code for extracting program counters from signal contexts.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory using mmap if available, for internal stack trace operations.

methods.name: Deallocate
methods.description: Deallocates memory allocated by Allocate, using munmap if available.

methods.name: DumpPCAndFrameSize
methods.description: Prints a program counter and its stack frame size.

methods.name: DumpPCAndSymbol
methods.description: Prints a program counter and its symbol name.

methods.name: DumpPCAndFrameSizeAndSymbol
methods.description: Prints a program counter, its frame size, and symbol name.

methods.name: RegisterDebugStackTraceHook
methods.description: Registers a custom hook for stack trace symbolization.

methods.name: GetDebugStackTraceHook
methods.description: Retrieves the current hook for stack trace symbolization.

methods.name: GetProgramCounter
methods.description: Extracts the program counter from a signal context, platform-specific implementation.

methods.name: DumpPCAndFrameSizesAndStackTrace
methods.description: Outputs a stack trace with optional symbolization.

methods.name: DumpStackTrace
methods.description: Captures and outputs the current stack trace, with optional symbolization and hook invocation.
